note: BLM (Butte Field Office) campground on the Big Hole River, 7 mi west of Wise River on MT Hwy 43 (BLM: from I-15 exit 102, 19.4 mi on MT-43, then left on Bryant Creek Rd). Shaded; each site has a gravel parking pad, picnic table and fire ring with a cooking grill. Dirt boat launch on site for rafts, canoes and small boats; nearby East Bank Campground has the better ramp for drift boats. --Claude
summary: BLM page confirms 10 FCFS sites (no reservations), RVs to 24 ft, one vault toilet, no drinking water, 14-day limit; added $15/night (April 1 - Nov 30). Not stated: season, electric/dump (derived no-electric/no-water hookups and no dump left). Note trimmed of restated sites/length/toilet/water/hookup/FCFS/limit text; the 'boat launch 1 mi west at East Bank' line corrected (BLM: a dirt launch on site, East Bank's ramp is for drift boats).
